title: Ruthless Coffee Tobacco Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Coffee Tobacco by Ruthless brings together two timeless flavours in a perfectly balanced blend. The deep, roasted intensity of freshly brewed Coffee meets the rich, earthy warmth of hand-rolled Tobacco, creating a bold and satisfying vape with a refined, aromatic finish. This combination is ideal for those who enjoy complex, full-bodied flavours that unfold with every inhale. One of many incredible flavours found in the celebrated Ruthless Shortfill collection, Coffee Tobacco features a 70VG/30PG ratio for dense vapour production and a smooth inhale. Designed for Sub-Ohm vape kits and advanced DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, it comes in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing for a customisable nicotine strength. Ruthless has been shaping the e-liquid industry for over a decade, creating bold, flavourful blends that continue to stand the test of time. Their commitment to premium ingredients and expert craftsmanship ensures a top-tier vaping experience in every bottle.
